en.headline: Sold-out Leslie Cheung 70th-birthday concert plays West Kowloon tonight
en.dek: The outdoor show at the AXA Bamboo Theatre starts at 7.15pm, with a 1,956-drone display timed for 9.12pm.
body: A sold-out concert marking what would have been Leslie Cheung’s 70th birthday takes place tonight at the AXA Bamboo Theatre in the West Kowloon Cultural District.

Organisers Florence Chan and Cheng Dan-shui said Continue to Love · Leslie Cheung 70th Birthday Concert begins at 7.15pm on Saturday. Tickets in two price tiers of HK$1,180 and HK$580 have all been sold. Chan said guest performers had already begun rehearsals and that net proceeds after necessary expenses are intended for a longer-term Cheung memorial hall and a statue.

The announced line-up, listed by the organisers in Chinese-stroke order, includes Karen Mok, Sam Hui, Jordan Chan, Charmaine Chen, Ian Chan, Elisa Chan, Wong Lok-yan, Fung Hei-sit, Yan Man-fong, Michael Tse, Kenny Bee, Chung Yi, Niki Yan, William So and Tam Yiu-man. Because the venue is open-air, the production team has prepared rain capes designed by art director William Chang for the audience.

A drone sequence using 1,956 aircraft — a figure matching Cheung’s birth year — is scheduled at 9.12pm. The same birthday date is also being marked by a separate free photography exhibition at the Hong Kong Design Institute in Tseung Kwan O, which opened on Saturday and runs until 15 November.

zh.headline: 張國榮70誕辰音樂會今晚西九舉行 門票售置
zh.dek: 《繼續寵愛·張國榮70誕辰·音樂會》今晚7時15分於安盛竹翠公園開場，主辦方安排1,956部無人機於9時12分升空。
body: 紀念張國榮70歲誕辰的戶外音樂會今晚於西九文化區安盛竹翠公園舉行，門票已經售置。
由陳淑芬及鄭丹瑞統籌的《繼續寵愛·張國榮70誕辰·音樂會》於周六晚上7時15分開始，票價分為1,180元及580元兩種。陳淑芬表示演出嘉賓已展開綱排，扣除必要開支後的收益計劃用於籌建較長遠的張國榮紀念館及銅像。
主辦方公布的演出名單按姓氏筆劃排列，包括莫文蔚、許冠傑、張衛健、陳松伶、陳卓賢、陳潔靈、黃洛妍、馮熙燎、甄敏芳、謝天華、鍾鎮濤、鍾懿、顏米羔、蘇永康及譚耀文。由於場地為露天，製作團隊為入場觀眾準備由美術指導奚仲文設計的雨衣。
音樂會進行至晚上9時12分，將有1,956部無人機升空組成圖案，數字取自張國榮的出生年份。同日，香港知專設計學院亦有免費紀念攝影展開放，展期至11月15日。
